title: The Young Men of New Orleans, 1969
summary: Garland half remembers playing with the Young Men of New Orleans, a band led by Earl Dancer.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: All right, well I think it's about time. Now how about this group, the Young Men of New Orleans? Remember about 1969?
That's a young man. That was the band, the 12, was it the young men or the 12 men from --
Well I have -- in my notes it says the young men.
Oh, the Young Men from New Orleans?
Yeah, that was boy named Earl Dancer. I think had that band. Yeah. They ain't got me playing with that band, did they?
Oh, yes this book -- these books Do. We're correcting everything, now, this is telling it like it is. Like it was, so did you not play with that band, the Young Men of New Orleans.
I know I played with them all right, Yeah, but I --
